entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Naresh Kumar Mehta, Adv.
 For the Informant : Mr. Kuldeep Kumar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sharda Kumari, App

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Ramesh Chand
 Malviya
 Oral Order
3 16-04-2024
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner is in custody in connection with Bhimpur P.S Case No. 61 of 2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 494, 365, 366(A), 376/34 of the I.P.C. and Section 4, POCSO Act.
3. As per prosecution case, As alleged petitioner has kidnapped the daughter of the informant.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
It is next submitted that victim stated in her statement under Section 164 and 161 of the Cr.P.C that no forced is used by the petitioner on her and she went from her house in her own will.
It is also Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.12770 of 2024(3) dt.16-04-2024 submitted that victim and petitioner were involved in love affair due to that victim solemnized marriage with petitioner.
It is further submitted that petitioner has no criminal antecedent as stated in para 3 of the bail petition.

It is also submitted that petitioner is in judicial custody since 09.06.2023.
5.
However, learned APP for the State oppose the prayer for regular bail of the petitioner.

6. On perusal of the FIR, impugned order, case diary , and statement of the victim in 161 and 164 Cr.P.C and also considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and submissions made Ravindra Ram @ Ravindra Kumar Ram vs The State Of Bihar on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129263607/

(Ramesh Chand Malviya, J) Mayank/-
